## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 93 captures during March 2025. This report provides a concise account of activity for the month, including the number of captures completed, image quality outcomes, and grading results. The figures should be used to support routine review of service delivery and to identify any operational matters requiring follow-up.

The recorded activity provides the basis for considering the quality and timeliness of the work completed during the reporting period. Any relevant issues should continue to be documented through the usual local processes.

## Image quality

Of the 93 captures, 12 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 12.9. This outcome should be reviewed as part of ongoing quality monitoring. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be considered through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

There were 13 referable results. The median grading lag was 1. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for grading during March 2025 and should be considered alongside the activity and image quality findings. Further operational review should focus on maintaining timely grading and addressing any recurring issues affecting image quality.
